summary: Continued the sole existing Draft PR #57 and preserved all prior Batch 015 commits. Corrected the frozen 100-case corpus so assertion answers do not leak into prompts, added automatic evidence-sufficiency refocus with truthful no-store/provider telemetry, executed a benchmark-only historical 3072-long-edge comparison on both long fixtures, regenerated benchmark outputs, and passed all repository/package/built gates plus final PR CI. Hosted visual-provider quality remains an honest SKIP because no explicitly authorized provider credential was available.
